'''October 2001 Lancaster tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Lancaster, Pennsylvania on 6 October 2001. It is known from Rypcord Kline's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3066">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-21-lancaster-10-06-01d3066/ lancaster-10-06-01], DeckTech (Rypcord "Rypcord" Kline, 21 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-21-lancaster-10-06-01d3066/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Lancaster, Pennsylvania
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
